question: A gold lion passant holding a sword in its right fore paw, is the national symbol of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sri Lanka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​**A gold lion passant holding a sword in its right forepaw is the national symbol of Sri Lanka. 
 
• It is also called the **Lion Flag**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f75fcb5a47eeb424599ea5784469f23a0d054686c70c898ab3fa5c10391c7c5.png] ​

 
• It consists of a gold lion passant, holding a sword in its right forepaw, in front of a crimson background with four golden bo leaves in each corner.
 
• The borders are yellow around the background, and to its left are two vertical stripes of equal size in saffron and green, with the saffron stripe closest to the lion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sri Lanka:**

 
 
• The county was formerly known as **Ceylon**.
 
• The current capital of Sri Lanka is Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte.
 
• Its **currency **is the **Sri Lankan rupee**.
 
• It is separated from the Indian subcontinent by the **Gulf of Mannar and the Palk Strait.**
